children: Oman’s Public Establishment for Industrial Estates (Madayn) has issued a construction tender for the Phase 1 infrastructure facilities at Thumrait Industrial City,
The construction tender was issued on 14 September 2026, with bids due on 12 December 2026.

The scope covers the development of infrastructure across an area of approximately 120,000 square metres (sqm), including roads, lighting, stormwater channels and culverts, sewerage and water networks, and landscaping.
The contract also includes the construction of plug-and-play units and a facility building.
“The contract is expected to be awarded in March 2027,” a source aware of the details told Zawya Projects, adding that the project is scheduled for completion in the second quarter of 2028.

Last week, Madayn had announced four investment opportunities in Sur Industrial City: the development, operation and management of an integrated medical facility, a training centre and a 182,000-sqm residential complex, each under a 30-year contract; and a 45,000-sqm quarry for backfilling materials under a three-year contract.
(Reporting by Deva Palanisamy; Editing by Anoop Menon)
